set.body:
Objective

Compute requested raw measurement blocks

C_xy,H = L_x B_L^T H B_R L_y^T

through independently verified dense and memory-bounded lowerings.

Scope and deliverables

- Implement a small dense reference evaluator separate from optimized production paths.
- Implement compiler-selectable routes that push a sparse or local K forward, pull a low-rank H backward, contract factorizations directly, stack scalar legs, and compute requested multivariate blocks only.
- Extend feature blocking, source sessions, memory preflight, deterministic reduction, and failure receipts to open-neural-boundary tasks.
- Add cost and memory models that choose routes without changing the scientific estimand.
- Prohibit default construction of the full p_L by p_R neural operator or the Kronecker lift.
- Preserve ordered partition and operation-stage semantics in every route.

Acceptance evidence

- Every route agrees with the dense oracle across rectangular, sparse, low-rank, block-backed, extreme-scale, and near-degenerate fixtures under declared tolerances.
- Feature-block size, tile size, and eligible route choice do not change results beyond the numerical contract.
- Source revisions and preflight failures behave exactly as for effect forms.
- Memory diagnostics bound all live relation, factor, block, output, and replacement buffers.
- Benchmarks record representative scalar-frame and multivariate-edge costs.

Ownership boundary

Own numerical lowerings, scheduler integration, memory planning, and kernel tests. Durable result semantics and scientific views remain separate.

Deferred non-goals

No implicit all-to-all graph, nonlinear view, causal estimator, learned transform, GPU backend, or distributed executor.
set.title: Epic 4: Implement oracle and optimized measurement-form contractions
